evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected current native inputs, typed original ID-list source, parent/source-result destination order, independently named ID and BlackboardDouble children, same original byte spans and required following field. The nullable count, element-null program, eight-byte output loop and complete conditional conversion are individually authenticated.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Static default registrations preserve the concrete original/wrapper adapter and exact original type key; the list formatter has the identical source element pointer and source-list registration argument. Concrete wrapper conversion interface/return type, formatter vtables and reader forwarding join through current metadata.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Stored collection composition uses the reviewed default list and concrete ID wrapper formatter under ordinary generic inflation, initialized available-buffer paths and successful calls. Null ID wrapper and null ID payload are separate stored states. Actual provider/cache return and runtime MethodInfo are not observed.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Live provider/IFix selection, refill/error and allocation parity, evaluated IDs or finishCount, selected global Buff instances and accepted finishing effects.
